usage: agentware [-h] [--format {text,json}] <command> ...

Deterministic CLI toolkit for an agentware workspace.

positional arguments:
  <command>
    init                scaffold the external knowledge dir + seed index +
                        write config
    config              show the resolved knowledge dir
    profile             resolve the path to a per-user profile overlay
    attach              validate (and optionally --migrate) a candidate repo
                        for adoption as the shared KB (team-mode onboarding)
    index               manage the knowledge index.json
    skill               manage the authored skill catalog
                        (list/search/add/remove/validate)
    update              self-update the agentware package (fast-forward-only;
                        re-runs R-PKG-04/05 gates on apply)
    query               look up entries (O(1) by id/path/tag)
    learn               create + register a learning file
    decide              record + register an autonomous decision (R-AUTO-03)
    relate              declare a graph edge (e.g. --supersedes) on an
                        EXISTING entry, routed through the index writer
                        (human/agent-asserted, never auto)
    ingest              deterministic curated capture from a LOCAL source
                        artifact (dry-run by default; --commit registers a
                        reviewed subset)
    features            regenerate FEATURES.md from the knowledge index.json
    migrate             KB schema migration runner: --list (read-only) /
                        --apply (idempotent)
    worklog             worklog utilities
    work                work-artifact utilities (team provenance)
    audit               run all consistency checks in one pass
    recall              deterministic BM25 ranked retrieval, token-budgeted
                        (budget-bounded output — never pipe through head)
    mcp                 read-only Model Context Protocol server over the KB
                        (stdio)
    eval                benchmark recall over a gold set (Recall@k,
                        precision@k, nDCG@k, MRR)
    bench               benchmark scorecard utilities
    metrics             execution observability over session transcripts
                        (read-only)
    fleet               org fleet observability over committed terminal events
                        (issues|impact); deterministic, read-only
    fleet-emit          append+stage ONE committed terminal event to the team
                        fleet sink (called by the loop; best-effort)
    team                org team onboarding: list | create | register
    dashboard           serve the read-only observability dashboard
                        (localhost-only)
    dream               run ONE deterministic, idle-gated KB-maintenance cycle
                        (Phase 1)
    kb-git              knowledge-base git sync (detection, commit, pull/push)
    steering            Deterministic Steering Format tooling
    org                 org-level KB tooling (lint)
    templates           team template tooling (lint)
    gate                release gate harness
    whereami            resolve the project/repo context for a directory
    plan                feature-plan structural tooling
    fanout              parallel-lane orchestration (isolated worktrees +
                        gated merge queue)
    trust               manage the HOME-pinned publisher SSH signing-key trust
                        anchor (~/.agentware/allowed_signers)
    release             release-signing utilities (read-only preflight;
                        key/tag actions are operator-gated via docs/release-
                        signing.md)
    tick                shared 30-min tick: dispatch due jobs (updater now;
                        P2c dream cadence additive), or install/uninstall the
                        StartInterval schedule
    checkup             run ONE periodic self-exam: deterministic aggregation
                        over P1 instrumentation + one bounded REPORT-ONLY LLM
                        narrative; writes a session-top report + tier-2
                        suggested workorders (opt-in, default OFF)
    prefer              capture a durable steering preference (say it once,
                        it's in force every future session)
    review              adversarial audit fan-out over a self-extension diff
                        (Opus/max)
    remediate           auto-fix confirmed adversarial-review findings
                        (Opus/max), each with a regression test, then re-run
                        the gate chain
    review-report       consolidate the gate's per-round audit + remediation
                        JSON into <feature>/adversarial-review.md, append a
                        self-closing worklog call-out per material finding,
                        and file a workorder per low finding
    graph               deterministic DAG orchestration over fanout lanes +
                        gated merge
    scaffold            emit a compliant new unit with all its wiring, and
                        audit the tree for units missing theirs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
